text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time to start training,
but I don't see Mejiro
Palmer anywhere, so I decide to
go looking for
her.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You're super duper awesome at
digging
holes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Good, aren't I? How about we
connect the
tunnels next?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Trainer. This girl was bored
outta her
mind, so we're digging tunnels
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Since you're here anyway, wanna join in?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh! I'm so sorry! It totally slipped
my mind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While her kindness toward the girl warms
my heart, I still warn her not to forget
about our
training sessions so easily next
time.
